claim: Implementation was added to TransferDesk.jsx
Watchlist state has shape { players: [], clubs: [] }
Watchlist state is persisted to localStorage
The localStorage key used for watchlist persistence is 'td-watchlist-v1'
Watchlist state is loaded lazily on mount
Watchlist state is saved on every change
Each TransferCard on the board gets a star button for the player in the top-left of the card
Each TransferCard on the board gets a small star button next to each club chip for 'from' club
Each TransferCard on the board gets a small star button next to each club chip for 'to' club
Each StoryCard in the story feed gets a star button next to the club name in the header
Each StoryCard in the story feed gets a star button on every candidate player row
A 'Watchlist' pill button exists in the controls bar next to search
The Watchlist pill button displays the total starred count
The Watchlist pill button toggles a watchOnly filter state
When watchOnly is active, the board only shows transfers where the player is starred OR the 'from' club is starred OR the 'to' club is starred
When watchOnly is active, the story feed only shows stories where the club is starred or any candidate is starred
Non-club placeholders 'Free agent' and 'Multiple clubs' are excluded from club starring
No build system exists in the repo
The component is a single-file component
Validation was performed using esbuild for syntax/bundling correctness
The esbuild validation did not involve running a dev server
